name: Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on social and employment aspects of restructuring processes: the need to protect jobs and workers’ rights
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking for action, not changing any law itself. It wants the European Commission to bring forward new rules and support so that when companies restructure, workers keep their rights. It calls for early talks with unions, training and new skills for affected staff, and help to avoid forced job losses. It also wants public money and public contracts to go only to companies that respect workers' rights and collective bargaining.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks the Commission for new proposals and protections.
- **Who it affects:** Workers and unions in restructuring companies, plus small businesses in supply chains.
- **What happens next:** The Commission decides whether to propose laws; the Council and Commission receive the text.
